summary: Garaina Airport (GAR/AYGI) is a small rural airstrip serving the remote settlement of Garaina in the Morobe Province of Papua New Guinea. Nestled in the rugged highlands, it provides a vital air link for the local community, which is otherwise cut off by challenging mountainous terrain and limited road infrastructure. The airport primarily supports missionary, medical, and charter flights rather than scheduled commercial service.
faqs:
Q: Does Garaina Airport have scheduled commercial flights?
A: No, Garaina Airport does not have scheduled commercial service. It is primarily used by charter flights, missionary aviation, and medevac operations serving the local community.

Q: What is the runway surface at Garaina Airport?
A: The airport features a short unpaved runway typical of rural Papua New Guinea airstrips, suitable only for small propeller aircraft such as Cessna Caravans or Twin Otters.

Q: When is the best time to fly into Garaina?
A: The dry season (roughly May to October) generally offers the most reliable flying conditions, as heavy rainfall and low cloud cover in the wet season can frequently disrupt operations at this highland airstrip.

Q: Are there facilities at the airport?
A: Facilities are minimal, consisting of little more than a basic airstrip with no terminal building. Passengers should expect no amenities on site.
transport_tips: Reaching Garaina by road is extremely difficult and time-consuming due to the steep, unpaved mountain tracks, so air travel is the practical option for most visitors. MAF (Mission Aviation Fellowship) and other charter operators occasionally serve the strip from Lae, the nearest major hub. Confirm flight availability well in advance, as schedules are irregular and weather-dependent.
local_tip: Carry all essential supplies with you, including food, water, and any medications, as there are no shops or services at the airstrip or readily available nearby. A small folding chair and rain jacket can make waiting for delayed or weather-affected flights considerably more comfortable.
